hardware_software: Ryzen AI 7 H 350 / RyzenAI-npu6 AIE2P / XRT 2.25.00 / firmware 1.0.0.63 / Linux 7.0.0-38-generic / project-locked MLIR-AIE and Peano; power mode not reverified
changes: One-submission, two-token BF16 ChannelMix: NPU norm/mix, sequential shift update, shared streamed key/value weights, exact ReLU-square and residual
Four key and four value workers; internal [core,token,channel] gather layout addressed directly by downstream kernels; diagnostic DMA scatters to token-major
Five BO ABI: x, parameters, weights, packed FP32 state/diagnostics/output, packed BF16 diagnostics; no CPU arithmetic or transfers between stages
Extract unchanged exact ReLU-square math into a shared size-specialized helper; use 32-element scratch on batched key workers
Remove the unsuccessful standalone five-stage FFN prototype; retain only the fused implementation and guarded C++ test

five_run_path.scope: Complete two-token BF16 FFN stage; model attention/WKV and prefill integration not included.

experiments.nine_BO_interface: Compiled but dispatch rejected before numerical validation; kernel log reported aie2_init_exec_req: Unsupported op 4. Packed five-BO version dispatches. No universal BO argument limit inferred.
experiments.strided_join_layout: Rejected during descriptor inspection: noncontiguous join offsets produced lengths of 2048/2048/2048/10240 instead of four 4096-element streams. Replaced by contiguous core stripes and downstream addressing.

fused_validation.scope: Complete two-token BF16 FFN stage; model attention/WKV and prefill integration not included.

fused_performance.limits: Isolated stage timing includes submit/wait and DMA, excludes setup, reset and host uploads/readbacks. Static weight payload is not measured bandwidth. Block means show drift; the approximately 2x stage gain is not a whole-model speedup claim.

relu_validation: activation scalar/vector2048/vector32/FP64 bits and guards passed values=9175040

production_helper_refactor.scope: No arithmetic changes intended. 128-token snapshots, 1116 checked vectors per precision. Single before/after benchmark pair per precision is a regression check, not a speedup claim. INT8 measurement is FFN+output mode.

remaining_work: Integrate a layer-wise two-token prefill schedule with DecodeGraph, sharing its resident weights, sessions and FP32 state; do not create a second model-weight copy
Bind fused FFN shift to the decode state and adapt residual-input gather to the existing projection/result layout without host copies
Validate prefill-to-decode logits and per-layer state, nonzero initial state, reset/branch, odd prompt tails and larger prompts against sequential production execution
Batch remaining attention matrices and add INT8 batched FFN; benchmark whole-model prefill before enabling a new default
Continue decode/INT8 bottleneck profiling; hardware-limit objective is not achieved
